parameters.query:
-- stale: no ok poll run in 2 hours, or no ok watcher run in watch_stale_min
-- minutes (read from config.yaml the way watchStaleFromConfigLine does). Before
-- the watcher's first run, the clock starts when the pod loaded the config.
INSERT INTO triage.heartbeat (name, last_success, watch_last_success, checked)
SELECT 'triage-poll',
  (SELECT max(finished) FROM triage.runs WHERE ok),
  (SELECT max(finished) FROM triage.watch_runs WHERE ok),
  now()
ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE
  SET last_success = excluded.last_success, watch_last_success = excluded.watch_last_success, checked = excluded.checked
RETURNING name, last_success, watch_last_success, checked,
  (last_success IS NULL OR last_success < now() - interval '2 hours'
   OR coalesce(coalesce(watch_last_success, (SELECT loaded FROM triage.config WHERE name = 'config.yaml'))
        < now() - make_interval(mins => coalesce((SELECT (regexp_match(E'\n' || body, '\nwatch_stale_min:\s*(\d+)'))[1]::integer
                                                   FROM triage.config WHERE name = 'config.yaml'), 30)), true)) AS stale;

nodes.name: Ping Home Assistant
nodes.notes: Runs the unsaved sub-workflow that holds the webhook URL, so the URL never enters this workflow's saved run data. It returns the status code only.

nodes.name: Record ping

parameters.query:
UPDATE triage.heartbeat
SET last_ping = now(), ping_status = NULLIF($1::integer, 0)
WHERE name = 'triage-poll'
RETURNING last_ping, ping_status;

nodes.notes: ping_status is the HTTP status, or NULL on a network error.

nodes.name: Ping failed
nodes.notes: Fails this execution only. triage.runs and the poll are untouched.

nodes.name: Retention

parameters.query:
-- At most once a day: claim the retention row (inserted on the first run),
-- then delete run logs older than 90 days. No claim, no prune. One statement,
-- so a failed prune also undoes the claim and the next run retries.
WITH claim AS (
  INSERT INTO triage.heartbeat AS h (name, last_success, checked)
  VALUES ('retention', now(), now())
  ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE
    SET last_success = excluded.last_success, checked = excluded.checked
    WHERE h.last_success IS NULL OR h.last_success <= now() - interval '1 day'
  RETURNING h.name
)
SELECT name, triage.prune_runs() AS deleted FROM claim;

nodes.notes: Runs after the ping branch (it sits below it). The deleted counts go to the n8n-db log via triage.prune_runs().
